ExchangeKind.description: Whether a user-role message was typed by the human or injected by the harness (a skill body, a tool-loaded notice, a task notification). Injected messages arrive while the assistant's turn is still open and must not open an exchange (requirement A-03).

ExchangeSpec.description: One user-role message and the turns that answer it.

gap_before_secs.description: Event-time gap between the previous exchange's last event and this exchange's first event. Compared against `gap_threshold_secs` to place arc boundaries (requirement A-06).

PromptClass.description: Length class of the prompt text the generator writes. Content is synthetic either way; the class only shapes byte counts.

TurnSpec.description: One assistant turn inside an exchange.

has_sentence.description: Whether the turn is rich enough to produce a `turn.sentence`. `false` yields a thin turn (requirement A-04).

objects.description: Objects the turn acts on; become entities in the expected output.

tools.description: Tool name and call count, in emission order.

verb.description: Sentence verb the turn should fold to (`read`, `edited`, `committed`, ...).

description: The whole spec for one synthetic session.

gap_threshold_secs.description: Arc gap threshold in seconds (default in production: 1800).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the first event.
